sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r11/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (openpyxl read_only, in memory): 'Quality Checks' row #30 and 'Internal Quality Checks' row #30 (same wording, empty annotation column); 'Deterministic Checks' sheet scanned
qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (full; esp. 'A negative needs a successful control')
evidence: Source design: every rejects/hides/absent/unchanged leg in the shipped criteria is paired with a same-kind success observed in the same review. (1) Global rule, tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:13: 'Every refusal row needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this review.' prompt.md:17 makes each role replay a fresh legal request carrying the current version and requires 'Send the same fresh request as Rafael afterwards (or before, on another card) as its control; a refusal for a duplicate, a skip or a full stage does not count as the role refusal'; a refusal that only reports the card as changed does not count. prompt.md:11-13 zero every binary row unless a UI-created job+candidate is read by the Observer in an independent context, so a blank/static/login-only app earns nothing. (2) Per-criterion pairing in .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r11/task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml: hro_job_open L29 ('the successful opening is the control'); hro_add_email_rules L47 (same address on a different job accepted, 'the control'); hro_move_one_stage L56 (one-stage moves must work); hro_reject_reason L83 (reasoned reject must move card); hro_reject_hired L92 ('A rejection of a non-hired card is the control'); hro_reopen L101 (own-stage reopen required); hro_interview_full L110 ('the two cards that entered Interview are the control'); hro_undo_full L128 ('same-kind control'); hro_mgr_early_refused L155 ('their late-stage moves are the control', plus prompt.md:17 Rafael control for open-job/add-candidate replays); hro_mgr_other_job L164 ('the job's own manager's move is the control'); hro_observer_readonly L173 ('Rafael's identical successful requests are the control'); hro_candidate_no_staff L182 (candidate data loads plus staff control, explicit 'Fails if ... the staff control did not succeed'); hro_anonymous L191 ('A signed-in success of each is the control'); hro_refusal_status L200 (controls 'as named in its own row', backed by the prompt.md:13 global rule); hro_stale_refused L209; hro_bulk_all_or_none L227; hro_bulk_places L236; hro_undo_conflict L254 ('same-kind control'); hro_undo_once L263 ('The successful undos are the control'); hro_activity_refusals L281 ('The successful actions' lines are the control'); hro_notes L290 (Rafael's and own manager's notes must succeed); hro_msg_compose L317 ('A normal send is the control'); hro_unread_counts L344 (count rises by two before the does-not-rise leg); hro_unread_scrolled_up L353 (no-jump paired with a notice within 15 s); hro_seen L362 (not-seen-after-Observer paired with seen-after-Tomas); hro_thread_access L371 (Rafael/Mei/Bill write; Rafael's read and send are the controls for refused replays); hro_candidate_private L398 (own data loads is the control; 'A candidate page that receives none of its own data is 0'); hro_restart L416 (no re-seed paired with persisted own records). (3) Gates: tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23 wrong password leaves visitor signed out, paired with correct sign-in to a usable workspace; render prompt.md:9 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control.' Constraints gate judge.toml:23 is all-positive. (4) tests/scored/polish/judge.toml: hro_pol_live_board L23 and hro_pol_live_thread L32 'If no update arrives within 15 seconds, preservation cannot be shown and this row is 0' (a non-live app cannot earn the not-reset/not-lost legs); hro_pol_failed_send L50 requires the resend to be 'sent once'; hro_pol_session_resume L59 names 'the positive control' and pairs Mei's empty boxes with Rafael's drafts still present; hro_pol_earlier_place L41 requires earlier messages to load above. Visual rows are Likert craft with no negative legs. Broken-app probes (reasoned from text, not run): blank/static/login-screen app -> global check zeroes all binary rows; app with no permission model -> refusal rows fail on acceptance; app where moves/undo/notes fail for everyone -> refusal rows lose their same-kind controls (prompt.md:13); app with no live transport -> hro_seen, hro_unread_scrolled_up and the polish preservation rows fail on their positive legs; app with no Activity -> hro_activity_refusals loses its control. Conforming-alternative probe: an app that hides forbidden controls rather than offering-and-refusing is explicitly accepted ('hiding it is optional'; prompt.md:23 uses a server replay), so it is not failed for a missing button. Residual observations, not defects of this row (P3): (a) 'not offered' legs (hro_notes L290 other-manager note, hro_reopen L101 reopen elsewhere, hro_thread_access 'not listed') can be satisfied by absence of a control; each has its positive control, and server enforcement relies on the prompt.md:23 'try' replays. (b) Role replays assume the captured request is session-portable; an app embedding a session-bound CSRF token in the body could be refused for the token rather than the role while Rafael's replay of the same body succeeds; prompt.md:17 ('only the rule or role under test can cause a refusal') mitigates, but a judge may not distinguish. Runtime: raw-evidence-index.json scope says 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; indexed evidence is a scripted golden driver only (qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/...). No configured judge run on a broken/weak app shows the judge actually withholding credit from negative legs when their controls fail, so run_verdict is NOT EXERCISED and risk=true for missing required discrimination evidence, not for a source defect.
suggested_fix: No criterion change required for this row. Before clearance, run the configured judge on a mutated weak app (e.g., moves/undo/notes fail for every account, or no live transport) and confirm the refusal rows score 0 for lack of controls; optionally make hro_refusal_status say explicitly 'Fails if any named control did not succeed', as hro_candidate_no_staff does.
